info.title: Recall API
info.description: Recall is a personal League of Legends coach. This API syncs match history, stats and rank data from the Riot API and serves them to the Recall frontend.

post.summary: Links a Riot account to the authenticated user. Responds with 200 and the same body if the account was already linked to the user

422.description: Validation error, account limit reached or Riot ID not found

302.description: Redirects to the frontend with status=ok|already|invalid

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.
